label: embedding
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{embedding}
    Let $Q$ be a WQO and suppose that $P \hookrightarrow Q$. Then $P$ is also a WQO and $\textbf{o}(P) \leqslant \textbf{o}(Q)$, $\textbf{w}(P) \leqslant \textbf{w}(Q)$.

label: w(S)
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{w(S)}
    Let $Q$ be a WQO. If $\textbf{w}(Q)$ is infinite, then $\textbf{w}(\mathsf{P_f^{}}(Q)) \geqslant 2^{\textbf{w}(Q)}$. If $\textbf{w}(Q) = n < \omega$, then $\textbf{w}(\mathsf{P_f^{}}(Q)) \geqslant \binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$.

title: Definition
body_md: For a preorder $Q$, the $h$-preorder on $Q$-labeled forests is defined by: $(F, f) \leqslant_h (G, g)$ if there exists a monotone function $h \colon F \to G$ such that $f(v) \leqslant g(h(v))$ for each vertex $v \in F$. The factor poset of $Q$-labeled forests (resp. trees) with $h$-preorder is denoted by $\mathcal{F}(Q)$ (resp. $\mathcal{T}(Q)$).

body_md: For WQOs $I$ and $J$, let $\mathcal{T}_s(I, J)$ denote the subset of $\mathcal{T}_s(I \sqcup J)$ of those labeled trees whose leaves have labels from $J$ and non-leaves have labels from $I$.

label: w(T) is monotone by X
title: Lemma
body_md:
\label{w(T) is monotone by X}
    Let $Q$ be a WQO, $r \in Q$, $\textbf{w}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)) > 0$, and let $a$ be not less than or equal to any element of $Q$.
    Suppose that $X$ is a non-empty set of trees, and for all trees in $X$, the root label is not less than or equal to $a$.
    If $\textbf{w}(X) \geqslant 4$, then $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\nleqslant r}(Q, a, X)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(X)$, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^r(Q, a, X)) > \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^r(Q, a, L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(x)))$ and $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\nleqslant r}(Q, a, X)) > \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\nleqslant r}(Q, a, L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(x)))$.

title: Theorem
body_md: For a WQO $Q$ of the width at least 3, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) \geqslant \varphi_{-1+\textbf{w}(Q)}(0)$.
head: environment

title: Proof
body_md:
First, we assume that $\textbf{w}(Q)$ is a successor ordinal. Let $r \in Q$ be such that $\textbf{w}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)) = \textbf{w}(Q)-1$. If $\textbf{w}(Q)$ is finite, then by \cref{w T(Q cup *)}, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)\sqcup\{r\})) \geqslant \varphi_{\textbf{o}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r))}(0) \geqslant \varphi_{\textbf{w}(Q)-1}(0)$ and we are done. 
    
    So, we assume that $\textbf{w}(Q)$ is infinite but not limit. Let $\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q)$ be the subset of those trees whose root is incomparable with $r$, and let $s \in L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)$ be such that $\textbf{w}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(s)) \geqslant 2$. By \cref{w T(Q cup *)}, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r,s)\sqcup\{s\})) \geqslant \varphi_{\textbf{o}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r,s))}(0) \geqslant 4$. Observe that $\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q) \supset \mathcal{T}^{L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r), r, \mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q))$. By \cref{embedding,w via w}, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)}(Q)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r), r, \mathcal{T}^{L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r)}(Q))) \geqslant f_{\textbf{w}(L_{\ifthenelse{\equal{}{}}{\bot}{\bot,}}(r))}(\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q)))$. Hence $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q))$ is a fixed point of $f_{\textbf{w}(Q)-1}$, so $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}^{\bot r}(Q)) \geqslant \varphi_{\textbf{w}(Q)}(0)$.

    Now, let $\textbf{w}(Q)$ be a limit ordinal. For any $\alpha < \textbf{w}(Q)$, there exists $Q' \subset Q$ of the width $\alpha+1$, hence $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) \geqslant \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q')) \geqslant \varphi_{\alpha+1}(0)$, so $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) \geqslant \sup_{\alpha<\textbf{w}(Q)} \varphi_{\alpha+1}(0) = \varphi_{\textbf{w}(Q)}(0)$.
head: environment

title: Corollary
body_md: For a WQO $Q$ of the width at least 3, $\textbf{w}(\mathcal{F}(Q)) \geqslant \varphi_{-1+\textbf{w}(Q)}(0)$.
head: environment

title: Corollary
body_md: Let $Q$ be a WQO such that $\textbf{o}(Q) = \textbf{w}(Q) = \alpha \geqslant 3$. Then $\textbf{o}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}(Q)) = \textbf{o}(\mathcal{F}(Q)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{F}(Q)) = \varphi_{-1+\alpha}(0)$.
head: environment

title: Corollary
body_md: Let $Q$ be a WQO such that $\textbf{o}(Q) = \textbf{w}(Q) = \alpha \geqslant 3$. Then $\textbf{o}(\mathcal{T}_m(Q)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}_m(Q)) = \textbf{o}(\mathcal{F}_m(Q)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{F}_m(Q)) = \varphi_{\varphi_{\dots_{\varphi_\alpha(0)}}(0)}(0)$ (with $m$ applications of $\varphi$).
head: environment

title: Corollary
body_md: For any $k \geqslant 3$, $\textbf{o}(\mathcal{T}_\omega\left(\overline{k}\right)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{T}_\omega\left(\overline{k}\right)) = \textbf{o}(\mathcal{F}_\omega\left(\overline{k}\right)) = \textbf{w}(\mathcal{F}_\omega\left(\overline{k}\right)) = \Gamma_0$, where $\Gamma_0$ is a Feferman–Schütte ordinal -- the least $\alpha$ such that $\varphi_\alpha(0) = \alpha$.
head: environment
